publications.title: Description-Guided CLIP (Ye et al., 2026)
publications.verificationNotes: Exact title, venue, datasets/versions, prompt and shot setup, split design, metric calculation, and calibration procedure must be verified from the paper. Do not quote these numbers as established facts until checked.
publications.relevanceNote: Project notes report Description-Guided CLIP results: 16-shot accuracy of 93.16% on PlantVillage, 79.30% on Cassava, 96.56% on Pear, and 56.96% on 21-class PlantDoc cross-domain evaluation. The notes distinguish local evidence calibration from conventional confidence calibration.

publications.title: BLAP (Xiong et al., 2026)
publications.verificationNotes: Full title, dataset composition, metrics, split design, field-test protocol, and exact meaning of the reported results are unverified. A 36-image test cannot by itself establish broad field generalisation.
publications.relevanceNote: Project notes describe BLAP as involving 990 images, 11 crops, 33 categories, reported 92.78% accuracy, and a 360-image wheat-field evaluation with 36/36 test images reportedly correct. The notes also associate the work with OOD, leave-one-crop-out, severity, and recommendation validation.

publications.title: Leakage or session splits (Kang, 2026)
publications.verificationNotes: The exact paper, dataset, sensor-reading definition, overlap method, and result are unverified. Confirm that the study concerns the relevant crop-disease dataset.
publications.relevanceNote: Project notes report a result that 91.9% of CDD test images share sensor readings with training images, motivating session/farm-disjoint evaluation.

publications.title: AgriPath-LF16 (Mooraj et al., 2026)
publications.verificationNotes: Dataset release, version, image count, class distribution, field provenance, licensing, and split metadata are unverified.
publications.relevanceNote: AgriPath-LF16 was discussed as a possible field-oriented dataset lead; project notes mention 111,000 images, 16 crops, and 41 diseases.

publications.title: CCMT crop-disease image dataset
publications.verificationNotes: All counts, release/version, crop/category distribution, licences, duplicate/augmentation lineage, and split overlap must be checked against the dataset documentation. Do not treat augmented images as independent original samples.
publications.relevanceNote: Candidate dataset for testing leakage-aware splits and reliability under field/domain shift. Project notes report 24,881 original images plus 102,976 augmented images across four crops and 22 categories.
